inventory_entry: HIFLD inventory describes the 2021-2022 NCES Private School Survey cohort and identifies ORNL as publisher.
inventory_archive: DataLumos project 240536, version V1; retained only as inventory provenance, not used as an approved comparison baseline.
candidate_producer: National Center for Education Statistics (NCES), Education Demographic and Geographic Estimates (EDGE)
service_difference: The service uses OBJECTID/NMCNTY and EPSG:4269; the separate NCES ZIP uses PPIN/NAMELSAD and EPSG:4326. These representations are kept distinct; no service-to-ZIP row parity is claimed.

predecessor_evidence.interpretation: Distinct official prior-period NCES archive. Counts, field list and CRS differ from the 2023-2024 ZIP; no row-by-row continuity or HIFLD baseline equivalence is asserted.

candidate_status: Draft changed-successor candidate; not a currentness or HIFLD-equivalence assertion.
